column1: # 5x5 km sample squares — one per Bundesland.
# Each square is aligned to the UTM kilometre grid in the state's OWN CRS, so it lands
# exactly on the 1 km tile boundaries the LiDAR products use (no partial tiles).
# CRS per state follows bundeslaender.md: 25833 for BB/BE/MV/SN, 25832 everywhere else.
# Placement rule (chosen 2026-07-28): the three city-states sample their capital, because
# there is no other choice; the other 13 sample terrain worth exercising a DGM with, biased
# toward locations that still contain real settlement so the cadastre layer is not empty.
# bbox is minE,minN,maxE,maxN in UTM kilometres — the same interface the LiDAR downloaders
